Nina Patel (FinOps): Postmortem: 2026-04-07 delayed token ingestion caused ~6h undercount for ~290 customers. Backfill completed but 74 accounts show ledger mismatches. Need owners and timeline for credits/invoice patches + audit file. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-04-07-metering.
Omar Hassan (Eng Infra): Root cause: consumer paused during rolling maintenance and compaction removed replay segments for some partitions. Short log: `2026-04-07T02:11:09Z consumer paused_for_rebalance true`. We have a replay tool but need a safe dry-run export.
Claire Torres (Customer Success): I can own customer comms for Medium+ accounts and coordinate outreach. Small credits can be auto-applied. Will prepare templates.
Nina Patel (FinOps): Need machine CSV: account_id, token_delta, proposed_credit_usd, ledger_tx_id_placeholder. Deadline for CSV: 1769510400 (2026-04-08 EOD).
Omar Hassan (Eng Infra): Will deliver a dry-run CSV and the script `tools/metering/delta_export.py` with `--dry-run` by the deadline. Example: `python delta_export.py --start 2026-04-07T00:00Z --end 2026-04-07T08:00Z --dry-run > deltas-20260407.csv`.
AlertBot: AUTO: Created ticket ENG-9408 for replay tool and FIN-5088 for credits queue.
Claire Torres (Customer Success): I'll prepare comms and own manual outreach for accounts where proposed_credit_usd > $50. Draft due 2026-04-09.
Nina Patel (FinOps): Policy proposal: credits <$12 auto, $12-$150 invoice patch, >$150 flagged for review. I'll formalize and post to FIN-5088 by 1769516800.
Omar Hassan (Eng Infra): Quick mitigation plan: 1) run dry-run CSV, 2) run controlled replay for affected partitions to validate ledgers, 3) apply credits via billing tool with ledger txs attached. Adding CI smoke test for a sample replay.
Nina Patel (FinOps): Action items recap: 1) Omar: dry-run CSV + script (due 1769510400) linked ENG-9408; 2) Claire: comms + outreach (due 1769596800); 3) Nina: finalize invoice policy (due 1769516800); 4) Ops: add consumer-lag alert >10m (ENG-9408). Weekly remediation check-ins until FIN-5088 closed.
Omar Hassan (Eng Infra): Will tag PR and attach sha to ENG-9408. Dry-run CSV ETA: will post in ticket when ready.
Claire Torres (Customer Success): Shared sheet link placeholder: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED - I've invited Finance, Billing, and Eng.
billing-bot: AUTO: FIN-5088 created and linked to ENG-9408.
Nina Patel (FinOps): Please ensure each credit row includes a short memo for audit and a ledger_tx_id when applied. We won't finalize credits without ledger entries.
Omar Hassan (Eng Infra): Noted. Will include checksum and test plan with CSV.
Nina Patel (FinOps): Next sync Wednesday 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. If blockers, update FIN-5088 and ping thread. Thanks all.
